opus.problem: Clues 4, 5 and 6 all give the same kind of fact: God has a child named for a judgment on Israel. Meanwhile, one of the best-known Hosea stories is left out: the LORD sends him to love an adulterous wife again, and he buys her back for fifteen shekels of silver and barley (Hosea 3:1-2). One of the child-naming clues, such as this one, should be swapped for that story.
